companyIntro.name: Civica Facilities Management
companyIntro.mission: Keep buildings safe, comfortable and cost-effective throughout their life.
companyIntro.culture: Preventive over reactive. Every asset has an owner, a schedule and a record.

projectBackground.name: Corporate Campus FM
projectBackground.context: The client questions FM cost and has had two air-conditioning failures. You must show control.

manager.name: Omar Haddad
manager.role: Head of FM, Civica Facilities Management
manager.note: Keep it simple: what's planned, what's done, what it costs and what we saved.

assignment.title: Show control of the campus
assignment.brief: Calculate PPM compliance, cost per m², energy saving, benchmark buildings in Excel and write a client update.

documents.name: PPM Report
documents.note: 200 planned tasks scheduled; 188 completed on time.

tasks.title: PPM Compliance
tasks.prompt: 188 of 200 planned tasks were completed on time. What is compliance (%)?
tasks.reasoning: Compliance shows discipline in preventive work.
tasks.mistake: Counting all tasks equally hides critical misses.
tasks.recommendation: Write down your reasoning and the evidence behind it so a reviewer can verify your conclusion quickly.

tasks.title: Cost per m²
tasks.prompt: Annual FM cost is €1,200,000 for 40,000 m². What is cost per m² (€)?
tasks.mistake: Comparing absolute costs of different sizes misleads.
tasks.recommendation: Write down your reasoning and the evidence behind it so a reviewer can verify your conclusion quickly.

tasks.title: Energy Saving
tasks.prompt: 150,000 kWh at €0.18 per kWh, with a 12% saving target. What is the annual saving (€)?
tasks.mistake: Reporting kWh without € hides the value.
tasks.recommendation: Write down your reasoning and the evidence behind it so a reviewer can verify your conclusion quickly.

tasks.title: Reactive vs Planned
tasks.prompt: Two A/C units failed. What reduces repeat failures?
options: Planned preventive maintenance with condition checks
tasks.mistake: Reactive-only models cost more over time.
tasks.recommendation: Write down your reasoning and the evidence behind it so a reviewer can verify your conclusion quickly.

tasks.title: Building Benchmark (Excel)
tasks.prompt: Cost per m² in column D = C / B. Upload for checking.
tasks.reasoning: Block B is the outlier to investigate.
tasks.recommendation: Write down your reasoning and the evidence behind it so a reviewer can verify your conclusion quickly.

tasks.title: Client Update
tasks.prompt: Write a 3-5 sentence update to the client.
tasks.modelAnswer: Planned maintenance compliance is 94% (188 of 200 tasks) with the remaining 12 scheduled this week. Campus cost is €30 per m², with Block B at €36 above the portfolio; we are reviewing its contracts. The energy programme targets €3,240 in annual savings through scheduling and setpoint changes. The two A/C failures were traced to filters; we have added filters to the monthly checklist.
tasks.reasoning: A good update gives numbers, outliers, actions and what's changed.
tasks.recommendation: Write down your reasoning and the evidence behind it so a reviewer can verify your conclusion quickly.

caseStudy.title: Case Study: The Quiet Chiller
caseStudy.background: A chiller was run to failure because no one owned its maintenance. It broke in July, the building closed for four days and emergency hire cost €85,000.
questions: Why did no one own it?
What would a schedule have shown?
caseStudy.solution: Civica introduced an asset register with a named owner and PPM for every critical item.
caseStudy.lessonsLearned: Every asset needs an owner and a schedule.
